title: JMAP: state strings hardcoded '0', StateStore never wired in
description: mail/server.rs:94, email/query.rs:66, mailbox/get.rs:46, mailbox/query.rs:32: all return hardcoded '0' for state. StateStore (state/version.rs) exists with get_state()/bump_state() but is never called. RFC 8620 §3.4 requires state to change whenever server state changes. Clients that cache based on state strings will never sync. Fix: wire StateStore into all handlers; call bump_state() on any write that changes Email or Mailbox objects.
